tiktok.rule: Use hook, body, close; communicate the emotional question or value in the first 3-6 seconds.

instagram.rule: Publish original Arcanea-created visuals and captions or approved partner work before recommendation review.

youtube_shorts.rule: Use vertical or square Shorts up to 3 minutes; this queue prioritizes 15-45 second proof/story cuts first.

x.rule: Use concise visual-led awareness posts with one thought and one next action.

approval_rules: No external publishing before human approval.
Keep provenance and VIS sidecars attached.
Treat rights as unknown until VIS rights ingestion upgrades the field.
Do not write DB registry records or mint web3 artifacts until a separate worthiness review passes.

campaigns.instagram_caption: A proof artifact only holds when the team holds together. Unity Gate: cooperation as infrastructure.
campaigns.tiktok_short_script: Start on the artifact shaking. Cut to the team stabilizing it. Close: Build the bridge together.
campaigns.youtube_shorts_angle: A 20-35s proof ritual: cooperation prevents the artifact from collapsing.
campaigns.x_post: Proof needs people. The Unity Gate is not solo mastery; it is the bridge that holds.

campaigns.instagram_caption: A blank ledger. A consent exit. A choice. This is where the Gate-Descent becomes human.
campaigns.tiktok_short_script: Open on the blank ledger. Reveal the friends holding the gate. Close: Choose proof over control.
campaigns.youtube_shorts_angle: A 25-45s story teaser for the first Gate choice, with no spoilers and no fake dialogue.
campaigns.x_post: The strongest gate is the one you can leave. Hold it open.

campaigns.x_post: A song is not gone when it leaves evidence. Voice Gate proof.
